description: R08 Host InputBuffer CP932 closeout: safe Rust now owns the final non-Unicode DBCS read contract by composing InputBuffer padding/order with a safe Windows Japanese code-page encoder.

entries.notes: The safe CP932 adapter encodes Microsoft's U+3042 fixture to 0x82 0xA0 and InputBuffer::read_with_codepage expands the DBCS key into two records while preserving mouse/key ordering and original key metadata.
